name: S&P 500 ETF (SPY) 10-Year Daily History
description: 10 years of daily OHLCV bar data for the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, extracted from Yahoo Finance via Pyodide with CORS proxy routing.

etl.script:
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd
import requests
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.ipc as ipc
import urllib.parse
from js import Uint8Array

class CorsProxySession(requests.Session):
    def __init__(self, proxy_url='https://corsproxy.io/?url='):
        super().__init__()
        self.proxy_url = proxy_url

    def request(self, method, url, *args, **kwargs):
        if not url.startswith(self.proxy_url):
            encoded_url = urllib.parse.quote(url, safe='')
            url = f"{self.proxy_url}{encoded_url}"
        headers = kwargs.get('headers', {})
        if 'User-Agent' in headers:
            del headers['User-Agent']
        kwargs['headers'] = headers
        return super().request(method, url, *args, **kwargs)

def fetch_and_convert_spy():
    proxy_session = CorsProxySession()
    ticker = yf.Ticker('SPY', session=proxy_session)
    df = ticker.history(period='10y')
    df = df.reset_index()
    df.columns = [str(col).strip() for col in df.columns]
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64tz_dtype(df['Date']):
        df['Date'] = df['Date'].dt.tz_localize(None)
    table = pa.Table.from_pandas(df)
    sink = pa.BufferOutputStream()
    with ipc.RecordBatchStreamWriter(sink, table.schema) as writer:
        writer.write_table(table)
    return Uint8Array.new(sink.getvalue().to_pybytes())

result_arrow = fetch_and_convert_spy()
